jobs.title: Office Assistant
jobs.description:

To put up previous papers and other references relating to the case under consideration.
To assist in the cases of recruitment and promotion.
To maintain service books of employees.
To maintain leave record of employees.
To put up cases for grant of loans/advances and medical facilities to employees.
To keep note of all important orders and decisions and maintenance of files of the Sections.
Any other duty assigned by the Officer Incharge.
Qualification:
Graduate.
06-weeks basic IT Training Course (including M.S Office) conducted by NITB.
Quota:
Balochistan-1
Location of Job:
Quetta
